description: Retrieval evaluation corpus for DocuQuery. Multi-page, text-rich public documents used to build the ground-truth query set and to produce BASELINE.md.
selection_note: Every document is a U.S. federal government publication and therefore public domain in the United States. That is deliberate: it avoids making a redistribution claim about a third-party paper whose licence would have to be verified per item. GAO reports were the original plan and were dropped -- gao.gov returns 403 to any non-browser User-Agent, and spoofing one to get past a publisher's bot policy is not a dependency this corpus should have. The trade-off of the sources that remain is a corpus skewed toward cybersecurity, risk-management and macroeconomic prose, which is noted wherever these numbers are reported.
